context: Hiroshi-boss and Ren plan a strategic shift.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business strategy; vocabulary (意思/転換/初期/試み/勝ち) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 会社の方針を、転換したいと思う。
lines.en: I want to shift the company's direction.
lines.style: decisive boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 転換には、強い意思が要りますね。
lines.style: engaged young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 初期の段階で、小さく試みよう。
lines.en: Let's try it small in the early stage.
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 初期の試みで、反応を見るんですね。
lines.en: We gauge reactions with early attempts.
lines.style: thoughtful young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 競争に勝つには、転換が必要だ。
lines.en: To win the competition, a shift is needed.
lines.style: firm boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 勝ちを目指して、意思を固めます。
lines.en: Aiming for victory, I'll firm up my resolve.
lines.style: confident young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 初期の試みが、鍵になるな。
lines.en: The early attempt will be key.
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 転換を、着実に進めます。
lines.style: resolved young manager voice, soft warm closing throughout
